items.title: US trading partners’ patience wears thin as Trump slaps on new tariffs
items.summary:
Major US trading partners and companies on the economic front lines decried US President Donald Trump’s latest tariff salvo on Wednesday, even as they expressed resignation, as his playbook has become more predictable and better telegraphed with repeated use.
This followed the White House’s proposal of fresh tariffs a few hours earlier on 14 major economies, including China, a week after Trump met Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.

items.title: US federal court blocks new Trump birthright citizenship executive order
items.summary:
A federal judge on Wednesday blocked US President Donald Trump’s latest executive order aimed at restricting birthright citizenship, dealing another setback to his ongoing effort to redefine what it means to be born an American.

items.title: Apex Neural Rendering Gives NVIDIA DLSS A Run For Its Money In Digital Foundry’s Testing, Introduces Game-Changing Comparison Tool
